Felix Beaumont
felix.beaumont@example.com | Pittsburgh, PA
Felix Beaumont has 16 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Windmere Infrastructure
(2022-2026), where they designed a GraphQL-backed data layer that cut p99 query
latency by 45%. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Ironwood Computing
(2021-2022). Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Northbeam Analytics
(2017-2021). Before that, Backend Engineer at Redbank Platform (2010-2017).
Education: B.S. Electrical Engineering, Metro State University, 2009. Core
skills: Node.js, AWS, Redis, CI/CD, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, REST
API design, Distributed systems, GraphQL.
